title: rbb24: Berlin Senate administration lags in addressing hacker attack aftermath
content_md:
rbb24 reports that the Berlin Senate administration is lagging in addressing the aftermath of a hacker attack. The report refers to the Senate Department for Urban Development.

Article link: https://www.rbb24.de/politik/beitrag/2026/11/berlin-senat-hacker-angriff-aufarbeitung-schadenersatz.html
exclude_reason: Follow-up on the previously covered Berlin Rhysida incident; the event text adds no new attack mechanics and no live candidate story exists.
